generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: Evidence is collected successfully but authentication or credential-bearing bytes are persisted or uploaded because safety checks run before final collection or are not a hard dependency of upload.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Redact one known diagnostic field while leaving headers, cookies, raw response payloads, or later-collected logs able to carry secrets into published evidence.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Authentication/session evidence must persist only allowlisted metadata; never persist raw response bodies, cookies, authorization values, or token fields.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Scan final evidence bytes after all collection and before upload; fail closed without echoing detected values, and make upload explicitly depend on scan success.

transfer_cases.evidence: Structured access-token fixture is rejected while redacted metadata passes.
Bearer authorization and session-cookie fixtures are rejected without echoing their values.

skill_changes.evidence: Generic delivery skill now requires allowlisted authentication diagnostics and final-byte artifact safety before publication.
Generic delivery skill now requires a fail-closed post-collection pre-upload detector and non-echoing scanner behavior; focused skill tests pass.
